title: 🕰️ Time & Space Archive
subtitle: The data timeline archive and glossary for the three boards — deep space, earth and ocean: the three-in-one orbital animation, a summary of current data status, live freshness, and unified search across every glossary entry.
orbitCaption: Sky (deep space) · Earth (earth) · Sea (ocean) — three in one. Click any planet to open the matching board
boardSummary: {count} data sources · rotation cycles and live freshness
footer: "Fetch Time" is when this site's proxy last pulled the source successfully (the dev server re-fetches automatically once its in-memory cache expires); "Data Time" is the time field declared inside the payload and varies by source (publish date / sampling time / observation time), and sources without a natural time field (such as orbital elements or statistical archives) show "—". All data comes from public free APIs and is for educational display only.
orbitAria: The live three-in-one orbit of the deep space, earth and ocean boards
orbitTip: {title}: healthy {ok}/{total}, faulty {bad}, waiting {wait} — click to enter
modulePlaceholder: Select the modules you want to inspect
moduleEmpty: Pick several modules from the dropdown above and you can view their live content side by side in a single view
llSubtitle: Type any real city name to get its latitude and longitude, browse the reference table of representative cities, or look up which country a coordinate belongs to.
llRefHint: Click any row to fill its coordinates into the lookup box below
llResultInvalid: Please enter valid latitude and longitude
llResultInside: Inside {country} (city {capital}); about {dist} km from its representative city
llResultNearest: Not within any country bounding box; nearest is {country} ({capital}), about {dist} km (likely open sea or near a border)
llTip: Each country/region carries an approximate bounding box and a representative-city coordinate. Lookup first checks whether the point falls inside a box (if several match, the one with the closest representative city wins); if none match, it falls back to the nearest representative city and shows the distance. Boxes are approximate sovereign bounds for reference only — not for navigation.
llCitySearch: Type a city name, e.g. Chengdu / London, GB
llCityHint: Matches Chinese, English, pinyin and local spellings. Cities sharing a name are sorted by population, and "city, country" narrows the search. The dictionary comes from GeoNames and covers about 63,000 settlements.
llCityLoading: Loading the city dictionary (about 3 MB, first time only)…
llCityError: Failed to load the city dictionary: {msg}
llCityEmpty: No city matches "{q}". Try the English name or remove extra spaces.
llCityCount: {count} cities in the dictionary, coordinates rounded to 4 decimals
llCityFilled: Coordinates copied into the lookup fields below
